verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
AYI Yesu Mukama,
Onsonyiwe-ebibi,
Omponye-okwegomba kw'ensi:
Mbeere mulongonfu.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Ayi Yesu Mukama,
Ommalemu okutya,
Mbeere omuddu wo-akwagala,
Ndyoke ntuuke gy'oli.

verse.name: v3
v4
verse.lines:
Ayi Yesu Mukama,
Ntuusa mu ssanyu lyo;
Mbeerenga eyo mu ggulu,
Emirembe gyonna.
